shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -50

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat index.html; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat vite.config.ts; echo ---; find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}'; echo ---; ls node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls __agent_eval__ .claude .agents; cat .gitignore
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && ls -R . && sed -n 1,200p references/package-routing.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && node -v && npm -v && npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version 2>&1 | tail -3 && npm view @gravity-ui/uikit peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15 && node -e 'console.log(require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json").version)' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -50
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; echo ----README; grep -n -i -A25 "required setup" README.md | head -80
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls components components/controls 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat components/controls/TextInput.md 2>/dev/null | head -120
sed -n 120,200p components/controls/TextInput.md; echo ====PWD; sed -n 1,200p components/controls/PasswordInput.md | grep -v '^$' | head -120
grep -v '^$' components/Checkbox.md | head -80; echo ====BUTTON; grep -v '^$' components/Button.md | sed -n 1,80p; echo ====TEXT; grep -v '^$' components/Text.md | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && wc -l .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && grep -n "Provider" guides/theming.md | head -40; echo ----; grep -v '^$' guides/theming.md | sed -n 1,60p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Provider Flex Card Button TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Text 2>&1 | head -60; echo ====; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && grep -n -i "flex" guides/layout.md | head -30; echo ===CARD; grep -v '^$' components/Card.md | sed -n 1,40p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Provider Flex Card Button TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Text 2>&1 | head -40; echo ====; sed -n 36,70p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && ls; find . -name "*.d.ts" | grep -iE "components/(layout|Flex|Button|controls/(TextInput|PasswordInput)|Checkbox)" | head -20; echo; grep -rn "gap?:" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5; grep -rln "export interface ButtonProps\|ButtonProps" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/Button/types.d.ts | head -80; echo ===SPACING; grep -rn "type SpacingValue" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3; grep -rn "SpacingValue =" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3; echo ===LAYOUTTYPES; sed -n 160,200p components/layout/types.d.ts; echo ==TI; cat components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls components/controls

cat components/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40 || find . -name "PasswordInput*.d.ts"; echo ===; grep -n "padding?:\|paddingInline?:\|width?:\|maxWidth?:\|direction?:" components/layout/types.d.ts | head; echo ===; grep -rn "export declare const Text\b\|export type TextProps\|TextProps" components/Text/*.d.ts | head -5; echo ===; grep -n "header-1\|subheader-1" -r components/Text/*.d.ts | head -3; echo ===; grep -n "onUpdate\|content?" components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; echo ===; grep -n "Card\b" components/Card/*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "Provider" index.d.ts | head -3

cat components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts | head -40; echo ===; grep -n "onUpdate" components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo ===; grep -rln "header-1" components/Text/ | head; grep -rn "'header-1'\|\"header-1\"" components/Text/ --include=*.d.ts | head -3; echo ===; grep -n "Provider\|Flex\b" index.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "export \* from\|Provider" index.d.ts | head -5; echo ===CARDPROPS; sed -n 1,40p components/Card/Card.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && grep -v '^$' guides/i18n.md | sed -n 1,40p; echo ===; grep -rn "onUpdate" ../esm/components/Checkbox/*.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -rln "onUpdate" components/Checkbox/ ; grep -rn "onUpdate" components/Checkbox/ --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "export.*configure" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3
cat components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; ls components/Checkbox
grep -n "ControlProps" -A 22 types.d.ts | head -40

grep -rn "interface ControlProps\|type ControlProps" --include=*.d.ts . ; f=$(grep -rl "interface ControlProps\|type ControlProps" --include=*.d.ts . | head -1); grep -n "ControlProps" -A 20 "$f" | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/' index.html && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
rm -rf dist && cat package.json && git status --short && git diff --stat
